Dogs must be leashed and well‑behaved. | The station itself doesn’t have special “pet‑friendly” amenities, but the trains do allow pets. |

If you’re looking for a place to stay near the station that’s pet‑friendly, I can help you find a hotel that meets your budget and pet‑friendly requirements. Just let me know your preferences!
